hypothesis: A public validated optimizer-coordinate snapshot can restore the exact archived positive-energy coordinate map and residual metric while independently recomputing a new mixed-CI objective. Restoring the numerical yardstick must not import a bare-reference stationarity certificate or secant history into the enlarged physical model.

authorized_scope.source: Read original optimizer and successor public resume implementation owned by native agent; communicate mathematical invariants and independent code review.
not_authorized_here: edit another agent's tests or docs

prospective_checks: Exact ordered orbital keys, complete disjoint shape/slice layout, coordinate dimensions and source/serialization policy identity
Finite real S metrics, original projector S-orthonormality, physical nuclear/workspace/no-pair model identity and compatible current functional geometry
Explicit coordinate point with same original linear map and orthogonal-manifold Gram; seed consistency must be verified without silently polar-normalizing or reconstructing a projector
Original inverse diagonal and every per-orbital inverse block preserved with their exact complete metric SHA; symmetry, finiteness and positivity verified before functional evaluation
No implicit Fock-spectrum, gap, population, diagonal or factory rebuild when an exact metric resume is requested
New target objective explicitly re-evaluated at the restored coordinate point; old bare-reference convergence flag, CI state, gradient and secant history not imported
Physical tracking and fixed target weights stay owned by the new functional; resume does not select or relabel target states
Original residual action tangent(x, original_inverse(tangent_gradient)) and energy indicator retain original definitions and tolerances
Invalid hashes, changed physical coordinates, incompatible real dimensions, projectors, nuclei, metrics, duplicate keys, missing blocks and unsupported update policies rejected explicitly
Returned checkpoint and diagnostics identify actual coordinate map and residual metric at accepted points; no expanded-model or experiment certification without those actual gates
Fresh optimizer default behavior preserved when no resume snapshot is supplied; API integration scope distinguished from full MCDHFSolver support

fixed_gate_identity.new_objective_reference: Declared 69-electron,24-radial,531-CSF equal-five-target mixed Dirac-Coulomb EOL objective; no new physical solve in this audit

successor_source_policy: The shared optimizer is expected to change under its designated owner. Preserve the original input epoch above; record the final reviewed bytes and source delta separately rather than changing this prospective contract.
acceptance: Independent mathematical and code audit may pass only for its recorded successor source epoch and declared public API scope. No new CI, gradient, optimization or physics certificate is produced.
stopping: Provide minimal interface recommendation, review owner's proposal/final source once available, report material findings and record source-bound read-only audit. No repeated old-model solves or unbounded follow-up work.
